purpose: Move one guard outside the blast radius of the script it guards. .github/workflows/ci.yml runs a single validation step, npm run check, and every guard in this repository is invoked by that one command from a string inside package.json. A one-character edit to that string turns CI green while executing no test at all, and no control inside the scripts can notice, because the code that would reject it does not run.

include: RFC-2026-007 recording the decision and the ownership transfer
One workflow step invoking node scripts/verify-test-coverage-floor.mjs before npm run check
Transfer of .github/workflows/ci.yml from WP-0A-A0-001, recorded in that manifest
One workflow step invoking node scripts/verify-branch-scope.mjs against the pull request's base, which only the workflow knows
exclude: Native branch protection, Gate G0 approval, any change to what the guard checks, production configuration, and any merge authorization

amends_without_owning.rationale: THIS INCREMENT (2026-10-06) touches nothing outside this package's writable_paths, so it declares no amendment: scripts/verify-branch-scope.mjs exits 74 on an amendment that explains nothing the branch changed. The previous increment (a5c33fd, merged) declared five paths -- evidence/VERIFICATION.md, scripts/test-suite-contract.mjs, scripts/validate-work-package-ownership.mjs, scripts/verify-disposition-branch.mjs, test-kits/integrity-manifest.json -- to close two High guard defects found by independent review; that record stays on WP-0A-A0-001.json, WP-0A-CON-008.json and WP-0A-A0-002.json and in git history.

acceptance_criteria: The workflow invokes node scripts/verify-test-coverage-floor.mjs as its own step, before npm run check, so a package.json edit cannot skip it.
The guard step precedes the composite step, so a failure is attributed to the guard rather than buried in a chain.
WP-0A-A0-001 retains every other declared output; only ci.yml moves, and the amendment is recorded in its ownership.amended_by.
npm run check still passes on pinned Node 24.20.0 / npm 11.19.0 with skipped and todo zero.
The ownership validator accepts the transfer with no cross-package overlap.

The workflow runs the branch-scope guard on every pull request, deriving the work-package id from the branch name and skipping cleanly when a branch names none. (2026-10-06: STALE in mechanism, not in effect. Since 8df0f4c (2026-09-02) the workflow no longer derives the package from the branch name: node scripts/verify-branch-identity.mjs resolves the branch to the one manifest whose ownership.branch names it, an unclaimed branch exits 75 and is then accepted only as a decision-record disposition branch (scripts/verify-disposition-branch.mjs), and every other unclaimed branch fails. That is stricter than "skipping cleanly". The criterion is judged against that behaviour.)
required_tests: Ownership validator across all manifests after the transfer
Repository protocol, role-separation, capability and secret-scan checks
rollback_or_forward_fix: Revert through a reviewed revert PR. One workflow step and one path moved between two manifests; no persisted data, provider state, credential, migration or customer-data effect.
open_blockers: This does NOT make the guard unbypassable. Someone who can edit ci.yml can delete the step. It moves the bypass from a place no control can see into a place a reviewer reads, and no further.
It does not close the digest class: a commit editing a guarded file AND its digest still passes. Independent review established that as a fixed-point property.

Gate G0 protected CI: no longer blocked on an external constraint. Native protection on main is live, measured read-only on 2026-10-05 (evidence/WP-0A-A0-001/product-owner-disposition-2026-10-05-g0-step2.md §6) and again on 2026-10-06 (evidence/WP-0A-A0-004/author-step2-and-retest-2026-10-06.md): required check "bootstrap", strict, enforce_admins true, force-push and deletion off, no required_pull_request_reviews. That evidence belongs to G0-tracker owner WP-0A-A0-001; G0's external verification is still not something this package or any agent run can give.

The ci.yml transfer's acknowledgement at WP-0A-A0-001.json ownership.amended_by[2] is PENDING and still names /root/r0_steward in acknowledgement_required_from. Since 2026-10-05 it is owed by /claude/r0_steward (step 2 item 2, evidence/WP-0A-A0-001/product-owner-disposition-2026-10-05-g0-step2.md §3 row 2). That file is outside this package's writable paths, so the successor records it there; it is not countersigned here.
Gate G0 remains Specification Baseline Complete / External Verification Pending.

The branch-scope guard runs only on pull_request events. A push to main carries no base to diff against, so the check is a pull-request control and not a branch-protection one; that distinction matters because protected CI is still an open Gate G0 item. (2026-10-06: native protection on main is now live and requires the check "bootstrap", which this workflow reports only for pull_request events and pushes to main. A commit therefore in practice reaches main through a pull request, where this step runs. That is inferred from the protection settings and the workflow triggers, not measured by an attempted direct push.)
